meta.name: gstack-autoplan
meta.description: GStack autoplan method for running a broad CEO, design, engineering, and developer-experience review before opening implementation windows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在实施前自动运行多角色评审
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在开发窗口开启前进行全面的CEO、设计、工程和开发者体验评审。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically run multi-role review before implementation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你提出复杂计划时，自动进行产品、UI、工程和开发者体验的综合审查，输出风险、决策、分工、验证和审批结论。
howto.when: 当你提出跨产品、UI、工程和开发者体验的复杂计划，或要求运行所有 gstack 计划审查，或明确说“$gstack-autoplan”时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 gstack autoplan 审查。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的综合审查流程。

say.text: 对这个跨团队计划做 autoplan 评审。
say.note: Claude 会输出风险、决策和分工等结论。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will automatically run a broad CEO, design, engineering, and developer-experience review for non-trivial plans, producing consolidated risks, decisions, downstream split, validation expectations, and final approval gate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a plan crossing product, UI, engineering, and DX boundaries, ask to run all gstack plan reviews, or explicitly say "$gstack-autoplan".

say_en.text: Run a gstack autoplan review for me.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the full consolidated review process.

say_en.text: Do an autoplan review on this cross-team plan.
say_en.note: Claude will output risks, decisions, and split conclusions.
